name: AG-UI
description: Agentic chat UI (Single Directory Component) for AI Assistant API agents, with a JWT token endpoint and anonymous flood/token protection.
project_description:
AG-UI Drupal Integration.

 This module provides an SDC (Single Directory Component) for chatting with an AG-UI compatible endpoint.

 Features 
 
 Streaming chat 
 Human-in-the-loop transactions. 
 Generative UI 
 Tool calling 
 JWT support (lcobucci/jwt) for remote calls 
 Custom tool integration for modules 
 
 README 

 It also provides a token endpoint to craft simple JWT's to pass to your applications to sign chat requests.

 As a demo, it also can convert the Drupal AI Assistant chat to be compatible. See "/admin/agui/demo"

 See: https://docs.ag-ui.com/introduction 

 
 AI Disclosure. 
 Note that extensive parts of this module, mostly the SDK implementation, was generated via AI coding agents under supervision.
